title: TSID
subtitle: Generate sortable IDs and recover their timestamps
intro: Create time-prefixed identifiers as 32-character hexadecimal strings and recover their embedded timestamps. Use them as internal keys, recent-first sort values, or pagination cursors when generation time is useful alongside a compact textual identifier.

reference.name: tsid()
reference.description: Generate a new identifier as a 32-character VARCHAR.

reference.name: tsid_to_timestamp(id)
reference.description: Decode generation time as a timezone-free UTC TIMESTAMP.

reference.name: DEFAULT tsid()
reference.description: Generate an ID when an INSERT omits the column.

reference.name: ORDER BY id DESC
reference.description: List IDs in descending time-prefix order.

reference.name: WHERE id < cursor
reference.description: Continue descending pagination from the last returned ID.

notes.title: Generation time is not event time
notes.body: The embedded timestamp records ID generation. Keep a separate event timestamp if events arrive late or describe earlier activity. Concurrent generation and clock changes also mean ID order is not a global transaction-order guarantee.

notes.title: Treat the format as its own type
notes.body: Store these IDs as VARCHAR and decode them with tsid_to_timestamp. This extension’s format is library-specific; do not assume compatibility with UUID, ULID, or other TSID libraries. Anyone holding an ID can recover its generation time.

examples.title: Generate keys automatically
examples.caption: The default generates one ID for each inserted row.

examples.title: Page through recent IDs
examples.caption: Run after the first example; the cursor comes from the previous page’s last row.

assertions: SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)=3 AND count(DISTINCT id)=3 AND bool_and(regexp_full_match(id, '[0-9a-f]{32}')) AND bool_and(abs(epoch(tsid_to_timestamp(id)) - epoch(current_timestamp)) < 300) THEN true ELSE error('TSID generation contract failed') END FROM events; SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)=1 THEN true ELSE error('TSID cursor pagination failed') END FROM events WHERE id < getvariable('cursor');
